_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: session_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "log_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscle" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "increment_value" REAL NULL, "increment_unit" TEXT NULL, "increment_grams" INTEGER NULL, "default_rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "catalog_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "strength_routine" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercise" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES strength_routine (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_set_target" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "routine_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routine_exercise (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "reps" INTEGER NULL, "weight_value" REAL NULL, "weight_unit" TEXT NULL, "weight_grams" INTEGER NULL, "rpe" REAL NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interval_workout" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "prepare_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interval_block" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES interval_workout (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES interval_block (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase_type" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "rounds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NULL, "utc_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paused_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "template_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "perceived_effort" INTEGER NULL CHECK("perceived_effort" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "note" TEXT NULL, "checkpoint_phase_index" INTEGER NULL, "checkpoint_elapsed_ms" INTEGER NULL, "checkpoint_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercise" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercise (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "weight_value" REAL NULL, "weight_unit" TEXT NULL, "weight_grams" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "rpe" REAL NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "logged_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interval_phase_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "phase_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "round" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "planned_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actual_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_record" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "achieved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_day" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("minute_of_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_interstitial_at" INTEGER NULL, "sessions_since_interstitial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "consent_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "ads_removed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ads_removed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_normalized_name ON exercise (normalized_name)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_muscle ON exercise (primary_muscle)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_exercise_catalog_key ON exercise (catalog_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_routine_exercise_routine_order ON routine_exercise (routine_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_routine_set_target_parent_order ON routine_set_target (routine_exercise_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_interval_block_workout_parent_order ON interval_block (workout_id, parent_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_started_at ON session (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_status ON session (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercise_exercise ON session_exercise (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercise_session ON session_exercise (session_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_set_log_exercise ON set_log (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_set_log_session ON set_log (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_set_log_session_exercise_order ON set_log (session_exercise_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_interval_phase_log_session ON interval_phase_log (session_id, sort_order)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_personal_record_exercise_type ON personal_record (exercise_id, type)
